listings.details:
### **Don't know how to install ? Read [this](https://github.com/Elaina69/Elaina-theme/wiki/Installation-instructions)**

- From Pengu 1.2.0 Beta test, theme will use PluginFS to store user's data:
  - For no PluginFS pengu versions, theme will still use default DataStore
  - For PluginFS pengu versions, user's data will be stored in ./data/ElainaData/json, old data from DataStore will auto migrate to new ElainaData

- Added "Disable theme wallpaper" option
- Added "Hide gamemodes" option
- Added "Window effect" option (Only available after enabling "Disable theme wallpaper" option)
- Re-designed settings UI
- Sanitized HTML/colors
- Faster sync users icons (for Pengu 1.2.0+)
- Updated custom avatar in TFT and Arena lobby
- Allowed users to copy wallpaper/audio/banner/font files name inside theme settings
- Theme now auto detect wallpaper/audio/banner/font lists (for Pengu 1.2.0+)
- The homepage navigation bar will be hidden by default
- No longer forced client restarts when installing themes for the first time or deleting data.
- No longer auto play wallpaper and audio after enable theme's wallpaper/audio
- Removed "Aram only mode" plugin
- Removed "Custom practice lobby" button

### **Sorry, you have to fresh install this version 😭**
After update, you should delete old cache:
1, Open DevTools (Ctrl + Shift + i)
2, Choose "Network" tab
3, Tick "Disable Cache" checkbox
4, Press Ctrl + Shift +  R to finish the process

listings.name: Snooze-CSS (Theme loader / Theme Creator)
listings.description: An advanced visual sculpting and analysis suite for theming the League of Legends client
listings.details:
## Key Additions

*   **IDE Bridge (Testing Phase):** Real-time, 2-way synchronization between Snooze-CSS and your external editor. Edit your theme in your preferred environment and see visual changes instantly in the client. 
    *   **Official Support:** Dedicated plugins for **Notepad++ (x86 & x64)** and a **VS Code extension** are now available for testing.
*   **Enhanced Generic Tools:** Improvements to some Generic tab presets. Including **Scrollbars**, **Settings Dialogs**, **Readability**, and **Background Dimming** have transitioned from simple toggles to granular sliders

## Technical

*   **Asset Validation:** Improved file pickers with a new validation layer. The file picker now automatically verifies if assets are correctly placed in the `/assets` folder and provides non-blocking guidance for invalid paths.
---

## 🛠 For Developers: IDE Bridge Protocol

The Snooze-CSS IDE Bridge is designed to be **IDE-agnostic**. If you wish to build a bridge for an unsupported editor (Sublime, Vim, etc.), the protocol uses a standard WebSocket transport.

*   **Transport:** WebSocket
*   **Default Port:** `8765` (Configurable in Snooze-CSS settings)

### Protocol Specification

**1. Client → IDE: Initialization (`init`)**  
Sent when the client first connects to the IDE to sync the current CSS buffer.
```json
{
  "action": "init",
  "css": "/* Initial CSS from the active Snooze-CSS profile */"
}
```

**2. Client → IDE: Visual Sync (`client-update`)**  
Sent when changes are made inside the Snooze-CSS Visual Builder.
```json
{
  "action": "client-update",
  "css": "/* Updated CSS from the client */"
}
```

**3. IDE → Client: Code Sync (`update`)**  
When a "Save" event is triggered in your IDE, your plugin should send this to the client. The client will instantly apply the CSS and update the "Raw CSS" tab.
```json
{
  "action": "update",
  "css": "/* Full CSS file buffer */"
}
```

> [!NOTE]
> The `css` field must be the entire file buffer as a single JSON-escaped string (e.g., `JSON.stringify(content)`).

listings.name: BLACKJACK ULTIMATE
listings.description: A blackgame made for pengu loader to play in league
listings.details:
🃏 BLACKJACK ULTIMATE v2.0 — Pengu Loader Plugin

Full casino-style blackjack running right inside your League client.

Core rules
- Real blackjack with 6-deck shoe
- Double down, split pairs, surrender (get half back), insurance on dealer Ace
- Pays 3:2 | Dealer hits soft 17 | 5-Card Charlie auto-wins

Cool features
- Side bets: Perfect Pairs (up to 25:1) + 21+3 (up to 100:1)
- Play 1–3 hands at once
- Hi-Lo card counting (running + true count)
- Live basic strategy coach + explanations
- Real-time bust % if you hit
- XP system + 10 levels (Novice → Casino Legend)
- 15 persistent achievements
- Last 20 hands history
- Daily tournament (1000 starting chips, resets daily)
- 4 themes (Dark Velvet, Runeterra, Las Vegas, VIP Black)
- Sounds via Web Audio API + mute option
- Draggable & resizable floating window
- Saves balance, stats, XP, achievements & history across restarts

🆕 What's new in v2.0 — Elaina Theme compatibility
- Removed floating card button (was being blocked by Elaina)
- Game now opens with Alt+B from anywhere in the client
- CSS injected at the end of <head> to win cascade priority over Elaina
- MutationObserver keeps our styles last if Elaina reorders them
- Overlay uses isolation + contain to prevent Elaina CSS from bleeding in

How to play
- Press Alt+B to open / close the game
- Pick your bet chips → Deal
- Controls: Hit / Stand / Double / Split / Surrender
- Left sidebar: stats, toggles for coach, bust %, counting mode
